text: There’s insufficient evidence to determine tree-cover loss on this rural asset (ASSET-K) between 2021 and 2025. No data sources (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, or MGAP 2021) were available to assess the claim. This doesn’t confirm whether tree-cover loss occurred, didn’t occur, or meet compliance standards like EUDR. The analysis is inconclusive due to missing coverage, not observational proof.
